notes: Colorado's All-State choral programs are CMEA (Colorado Music Educators Association) events, but each is run by its own committee on its own website: the High School All State Choir and the All State Jazz Choir at aschoir.com, the Middle All State Choir on a CMEA-hosted Google Site, and the Elementary All State Choir on a separate Google Site. CMEA's own /all-state-groups/ page is the umbrella page and is where the fee amounts are published. SEASON LABELING: the aschoir.com home page explicitly heads its list '2026-2027 Important Dates' and the CMASC site heads its list 'Important Dates for the 2027 Colorado Middle All State Choir', so the dates recorded here are genuinely the current cycle. Note that Colorado names its choir events by the calendar year the FESTIVAL occurs (the '2027 All State Choir'), while auditions happen in fall 2026. Two mixed-vintage hazards on aschoir.com were checked: (a) the site's news feed still carries 2026-festival posts (schedule, second-audition info, Fall 2025 audition schedules) alongside the 2026-27 date block, and those older posts were NOT used here; (b) the PDFs linked from the Auditions page (Director's Responsibility Form, Procedures and Requirements, Accommodation Request, audition site list) are all still the Fall 2025 / 2025.2026 editions as of this retrieval, so they are recorded as documents but no 2026-27 date or fee was taken from them. The audition format/scoring breakdown on the Auditions page itself is undated standing policy. The Colorado Elementary All State Choir is deliberately NOT included as a program below: CMEA publishes its eligibility and $55 participation fee but no 2026-27 dates were found on any page read, so there was nothing season-specific to record. CMEA also notes that all middle and high school All State ensembles are sanctioned by the Colorado High School Activities Association and follow CHSAA eligibility policy.

organization.name: Colorado Music Educators Association
organization.description: CMEA sanctions and lists Colorado's All State ensembles, including the Elementary, Middle, and High School All State Choirs and the All State Jazz Choir. Directors of auditioning or participating students must be active CMEA members at the time of both audition and participation. CMEA notes that all State ensembles in Colorado are sanctioned by the Colorado High School Activities Association and follow its eligibility policies.

programs.name: Colorado All State Choir
programs.description: The Colorado All-State Choir features top junior and senior high school choir students in the state. Students must be enrolled in their school choir and pass a competitive audition, and are placed in one of three ensembles: Treble Choir, Mixed Choir, or Tenor-Bass Choir. Auditions are held each fall at regional sites; participants rehearse with internationally recognized clinicians and perform a culminating concert at the Buell Theatre in Denver. CMEA identifies the 2027 festival dates as February 11-13, 2027, at the Embassy Suites and the Buell.

requirements.title: Junior or senior, enrolled in the school's vocal music program
requirements.description: Students must be a junior or senior and must be currently enrolled in their high school vocal music program. Home schooled students are required to be enrolled in their local high school's vocal music program in order to audition.

requirements.title: CHSAA sanction and curricular-ensemble requirement
requirements.description: CMEA states that All State ensembles in Colorado are sanctioned by the Colorado High School Activities Association and follow its eligibility policies. Home schooled students, or students at schools without music programs, must enroll and actively participate in a curricular high school ensemble; participation in a private or extracurricular youth ensemble does not satisfy this. Eligibility is verified at the time of audition.

requirements.title: Director must be an active CMEA member
requirements.description: Directors with auditioning or participating students must be active CMEA members at the time of audition and at the time of participation.

requirements.title: Prepared solo — original score required, 2:30 limit
requirements.description: A prepared solo is worth 50 of the 100 audition points. An original score must be provided for the judge. Jazz, pop, and musical theatre songs are not permitted. Solos are limited to 2 minutes 30 seconds; the judge will most likely stop the audition at that mark, and scoring is not impacted if the judge stops the solo. The site advises marking cuts in the original score, singing no more than two verses of a strophic piece, and cutting excessive introductions, interludes and extended cadential passages.

requirements.title: Audition scoring — 100 points across five components
requirements.description: Prepared Solo 50 points (tone quality 10, intonation 10, accuracy 10, diction 10, musicality 10); Sense of Tonality 10; Intervals 8; Tonal Recall 8; Sight Reading 24. Each student receives a raw score out of 100.

requirements.title: Sense of Tonality — scales and triads (10 points)
requirements.description: Major scale (2), harmonic minor scale (2), melodic minor scale (2), major triad (1), minor triad (1), diminished triad (1), augmented triad (1). Any method is suitable: solfege, numbers, 'la', etc. Scales are performed before triads.

requirements.title: Sight reading — 24 points
requirements.description: Melodic sight reading 16 points (2 examples, 8 points each) and rhythmic sight reading 8 points (1 example). Any method may be used — solfege, numbers, 'la' for melodic; beat numbers, 'ta', 'da' for rhythmic. Scoring occurs from what students say.

requirements.title: Intervals and Tonal Recall
requirements.description: Intervals (8 points): sing a requested interval from a given pitch (2 intervals, 2 points each) and identify the interval between two pitches (2 intervals, 2 points each). Any sung or hummed note is scored — students must not hum or sing to practice. Tonal Recall (8 points): a short melodic example is played twice on the piano with a slight break between playings, then sung a cappella on a neutral open syllable such as 'na na', 'la la' or 'da da' (2 examples, 4 points each).

requirements.title: Z-Score tabulation
requirements.description: Raw scores are converted to a Z-Score to account for differences between judges: (student raw score − judge's average score) / standard deviation of that judge. Choir cut-offs are made by Z-Score, and the cut-off differs for each voice part and changes every year.

requirements.title: Photo ID required at check-in
requirements.description: As of Fall 2024, auditioning students must present photo ID at check-in.

requirements.title: Regional audition site assignment by county
requirements.description: Students audition at the site assigned to their county under the published boundary assignments. Directors may petition to audition at an alternate site by completing the Petition Form for each student.

programs.name: Colorado All State Jazz Choir
programs.description: The Colorado All-State Jazz Choir is open to 11th and 12th grade students and comprises three auditioned ensembles of 16 singers each: Mixed Choir (SATB), Treble Choir (SSAA), and Tenor/Bass Choir (TTBB). Students complete a three-step audition process. Selected students rehearse and perform in January at the Broadmoor Hotel in Colorado Springs during the CMEA Conference, working with nationally and internationally recognized vocal jazz artists.

requirements.title: Grades 11-12
requirements.description: The Colorado All-State Jazz Choir is open to 11th and 12th grade students.

requirements.title: Director must be an active CMEA member
requirements.description: Directors with auditioning or participating students must be active CMEA members at the time of audition and participation.

requirements.title: Three-step audition; 16 students selected per choir
requirements.description: Students complete a three-step audition process and 16 students are selected for each of the three ensembles.

requirements.title: Assigned audition solo on a rotating cycle
requirements.description: The audition solo is assigned on a three-year rotation. The published rotation is keyed to the year the choir takes place (e.g. January 2027), not the year students audition (fall 2026). For each solo an mp3 accompaniment track and a PDF of the solo score are provided; access requires a password found in the Audition Information Packet.

requirements.title: Audition scales with reference recordings
requirements.description: The audition information page provides mp3 reference recordings of the required audition scales, including blues, chromatic, dorian, and major scales recorded per voice part.

repertoire.title: Foolish Heart
repertoire.notes: Listed as an assigned audition solo for the choirs taking place in 2027, 2030, 2033, 2036 and so on. Colorado keys the rotation to the year the choir takes place, so this applies to students auditioning in fall 2026. No composer is published on the audition information page.

repertoire.title: Four
repertoire.notes: Listed as an assigned audition solo for the choirs taking place in 2027, 2030, 2033, 2036 and so on. No composer is published on the audition information page.

programs.name: Colorado Middle All State Choir
programs.description: The Colorado Middle All State Choir (CMASC) offers 7th and 8th grade students the chance to audition for one of three ensembles: Triplo, Mescolare, and Cambiato. (CMEA's umbrella page describes the same three ensembles as Women's Choir, Treble Choir, and Men's Choir.) Designed as a bridge between the Elementary and High School All State models, CMASC requires a prepared audition piece and a demonstration of technical skills, and ensures representation from all CMEA districts. The two-day festival is held at the Colorado Convention Center in Denver with a culminating public concert at the 5,000-seat Bellco Theatre.
